metadata.title: Red Runaways II: Low mass Hills stars in SDSS Stripe 82

notes: No eligible stars. The paper explicitly states at T:p1-b8 that it finds no candidates with velocities exceeding the escape speed, at T:p4-b9 that all listed candidates are bound, and at T:p10-b6 that none of its Hills candidates are unbound. The 226 Hills candidates, 29 SHCs, and 5 PHCs therefore do not qualify as Galactic-unbound candidates. Previously proposed HVS candidates from Palladino et al. are only mentioned collectively and are not studied star-by-star here.
